tools.name: kya_register
tools.description: Register an AI agent for a Brazilian company: agent key (EVM address or Web Bot Auth Ed25519 key), CNPJ and a mandate (JSON, validated against /.well-known/kya-mandate.schema.json). Returns a one-time challenge the agent signs with its key and the company signs with its e-CNPJ (CMS/PKCS#7). Price co

tools.name: kya_verify_paid
tools.description: Same as the free verification, without daily limit, plus a signed receipt of the verification itself (what was checked, when). Pay per call with x402.

tools.name: kya_check_action
tools.description: Signed verdict: is this action (action, amount, currency, counterparty, payment instrument) inside the agent's mandate and is the credential active? Evaluates the reserved mandate fields; lists the fields it did not evaluate.

tools.name: kya_renew
tools.description: Re-issue the credential for 90 more days. The company signs the renewal challenge with an e-CNPJ in force (not revoked); the company must still be ATIVA at the Receita.

tools.name: kya_prove
tools.description: Free. Send both signatures of the challenge. The e-CNPJ chain is validated against ICP-Brasil roots, the CNPJ must match, the certificate must not be revoked (CRL) and the company must be ATIVA; then the credential is issued (90 days, Ed25519-signed).

tools.name: kya_principal_match
tools.description: Signed answer ($0.01) for a person's agent (principal.kind person): does the CPF you already have match the e-CPF holder behind it? On a match, a subject_ref of your own for that person (stable for you, different for every verifier). The CPF is never stored, published or revealed; 3 non-matching ans

tools.name: kya_person_agents
tools.description: Free, person only: every live credential behind your e-CPF and every CPF check made against each one. Sign "KYA Brasil: my agents\nat: <ISO time>" with the e-CPF (valid 10 minutes).

tools.name: kya_sign_link
tools.description: Free. Link for whoever holds the company's e-CNPJ (owner, accountant): give challenge_id and the agent's signature, get the /sign URL. They see agent, company and mandate and sign in the browser (A1 .pfx) or with any ICP-Brasil signer (A3 token, cloud), or run kya-sign (npm @kya-brasil/agent-tools)

tools.name: kya_verify
tools.description: Free (50/day per IP). The agent's current credential: principal company, mandate, status (active, suspended, revoked, expired) and signature. Also by key: /v1/agents/by-key?kind=&id=.

tools.name: kya_renew_prove
tools.description: Free. Second step of kya_renew: send both signatures of the renewal challenge; the credential is re-issued for 90 days if the e-CNPJ is not revoked and the company is still ATIVA.

tools.name: kya_revoke
tools.description: Free. The company revokes the credential at once (e-CNPJ-signed request). Revocations are listed at /v1/revocations.

tools.name: kya_company_agents
tools.description: Free, company only. Every credential ever registered for your CNPJ, any status, whoever held the certificate (an accountant, another employee). Request signed with your e-CNPJ over "KYA Brasil: agents <cnpj>" + "at: <ISO time>".

tools.name: kya_company_webhook
tools.description: Free, company only. Sets the https URL that receives signed events about your agents: credential issued, renewed, suspended, reinstated, revoked. Request signed with your e-CNPJ; url "-" removes it.

tools.name: kya_revocations
tools.description: Free. Credentials revoked since a date (default: last 30 days), for verifiers that cache credentials.

tools.name: kya_about
tools.description: Free. What KYA Brasil is, how the credential flow works, prices, and where the schemas and signing keys are.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "kya_revocations" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Free. Credentials revoked since a date (default: last 30 days), for verifiers that cache credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kya_sign_link · Private data: kya_check_action, kya_renew, kya_prove, kya_principal_match, kya_person_agents, kya_sign_link, kya_verify, kya_renew_prove, kya_revoke, kya_company_agents, kya_company_webhook, kya_revocations, kya_about · Public sink: kya_prove, kya_renew_prove, kya_company_webhook · Destructive: kya_sign_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kya_sign_link · Private data: kya_check_action, kya_renew, kya_prove, kya_principal_match, kya_person_agents, kya_sign_link, kya_verify, kya_renew_prove, kya_revoke, kya_company_agents, kya_company_webhook, kya_revocations, kya_about · Public sink: kya_prove, kya_renew_prove, kya_company_webhook · Destructive: kya_sign_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "kya_check_action" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
